parameters.query: UPDATE revenue_autopilot_jobs j SET stage=CASE WHEN a.status='approved' THEN 'approved' WHEN a.status IN ('rejected','deferred') THEN 'rejected' ELSE j.stage END,updated_at=NOW(),finished_at=CASE WHEN a.status IN ('rejected','deferred') THEN NOW() ELSE j.finished_at END FROM approval_requests a WHERE a.id=j.approval_request_id AND j.stage='awaiting_approval' AND a.status<>'pending'; UPDATE revenue_autopilot_jobs SET stage=CASE WHEN attempt>=max_attempts THEN 'failed' ELSE 'retry' END,next_attempt_at=NOW()+interval '1 hour',last_error='running lease expired',updated_at=NOW() WHERE stage='running' AND updated_at<NOW()-interval '30 minutes'; INSERT INTO revenue_autopilot_jobs(job_key,source_run_id,priority,metadata) SELECT 'local-run:'||r.id,r.id,CASE WHEN r.task_name='신규 수익 콘텐츠 후보' THEN 40 ELSE 10 END + CASE WHEN lower(COALESCE(r.metadata->>'topic_title','')) ~ '(buy|price|cost|review|commerce|product|tool|구매|가격|비교|제품)' THEN 20 ELSE 0 END,jsonb_build_object('source_channel',r.metadata->>'source_channel','topic_title',r.metadata->>'topic_title','topic_url',r.metadata->>'topic_url','provider',r.provider,'model',r.model) FROM local_llm_runs r WHERE r.status='complete' AND r.task_name='신규 수익 콘텐츠 후보' AND lower(COALESCE(r.metadata->>'topic_title','')) ~ '(\m(shopping|shopper|shoppers|commerce|retail|payment|payments|affiliate|product|products|review|reviews|price|prices|deal|deals|discount|discounts|coupon|coupons|comparison|comparisons|subscription|subscriptions|saas|beauty|travel|appliance|appliances)\M|쇼핑|커머스|구매|가격|할인|추천|가전|여행|비교|제품)' AND COALESCE(r.metadata->>'runner_version','0')='2' AND COALESCE(r.metadata->>'topic_url','')<>'' AND length(COALESCE(r.result_summary,''))>=200 AND r.updated_at>NOW()-interval '7 days' ON CONFLICT(job_key) DO NOTHING; WITH picked AS (SELECT j.id FROM revenue_autopilot_jobs j WHERE j.stage IN ('queued','retry') AND j.next_attempt_at<=NOW() AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM revenue_autopilot_jobs x WHERE x.stage IN ('running','awaiting_approval','approved','rendering')) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM approval_requests a WHERE a.request_type='revenue_content_publish' AND a.requested_at>=date_trunc('day',NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul') ORDER BY j.priority DESC,j.id DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED), claimed AS (UPDATE revenue_autopilot_jobs j SET stage='running',attempt=attempt+1,updated_at=NOW() FROM picked WHERE j.id=picked.id RETURNING j.*) SELECT c.id AS job_id,c.job_key,c.attempt,r.task_name,r.provider,r.model,r.result_summary,r.metadata->>'topic_title' AS topic_title,r.metadata->>'topic_url' AS topic_url,r.metadata->>'source_channel' AS source_channel FROM claimed c JOIN local_llm_runs r ON r.id=c.source_run_id;
